design-without-entry-acceptance.reason: Body entry promise has no corresponding executable acceptance; helper acceptance alone is insufficient.

explicit-entry-disconnected.reason: Entry content is available and statically contradicts explicit click acceptance; not a runtime deferral.

unchanged-entry-already-connected.reason: The supplied unchanged entry already calls helper; an absent entry diff does not prove a defect.

caller-context-unavailable.reason: No entry content: cannot prove either connection or disconnection. Do not fabricate a product finding.

compound-display-dimension-missing.reason: cost exists but input/output are absent; do not narrow the compound requirement.

wrong-span-aggregation.reason: Global range is 72000000, while the declared sum is 144000000.

legitimate-parallel-sum-above-day.reason: 144000000 is valid under the explicit sum definition. A 24h aggregate cap would be a false positive.

explicit-midnight-interval-clipping.reason: The explicit continuous-interval oracle clips one hour to each day; sample-bucket spans return zero. This is NOT a reproduction of any external product's midnight behavior.

fork-identity-explicitly-distinct.reason: Distinct fork IDs count separately by definition. Never infer a permanent merge policy from unrelated observations.

acceptance-formula-conflicts-with-outcom.reason: The acceptance formula itself contradicts the declared user outcome. Passing that checkbox is not proof of coverage; reconcile the contract instead of silently selecting its convenient formula.

milliseconds-contract-seconds-result.reason: The declared unit is ms; implementation divides by 1000 and returns seconds.

fork-task-identity-unspecified.reason: Observed file/sessionId count is 2, but logical task count has no authorized fork oracle. Do not choose permanent merging or separation as the product semantics.

runtime-recorded-handoff.reason: Only static presence/binding of declared evidence is admissible. Browser/human completion must not be invented. Record is a synthetic assumption, not a real runtime acceptance.
